Tina Mote

Tenured Mathematics Faculty, Triton College

I am a mathematics educator and doctoral student. My research focuses on trauma-informed pedagogy in mathematics teaching.

My experience spans mathematics instruction, developmental education, curriculum design, and faculty development.

Math trauma affects a lot of students.

My research brings together mathematics education and trauma-informed pedagogy within the field of higher education leadership.
